summary: Hayden Savage, 24, of Oak Creek, was killed when his snowmobile veered off a developed road and crashed into a tree near Stagecoach Reservoir; he was not wearing a helmet. Colorado Parks and Wildlife personnel performed CPR, but he was pronounced dead.
notes: Snowmobile tree crash. Date pinned via article's 'this past Saturday' (posted Thu 2018-11-29; 2018-11-24 was Saturday, verified). Source is an Unofficial Networks rewrite of the Steamboat Today article 'Man killed in snowmobile crash near Stagecoach Reservoir' (original not locatable; cited within). Precedent: snowmobile tree-crash injuries (e.g. id 2246) and CPW-lead fatalities (e.g. id 3014) are indexed. Inserted run 697.
